cited.quote: From 80 years to 84 years 43,050 20% of revised basic pension / family pension

rationale: C1 describes pension and the existing additional pension slabs for age 80 and above (as on 01-06-2021). No extract shows a GO or official step revising pension with a 10% hike from 70 years and a further 10% from 80 years. Other extracts are about health insurance, superannuation age or sugarcane.

No extract is about allocating at least 3 school periods for physical education. C1 and C4 concern physical education teachers' courses and the sports university, C2 sports admissions, C3 talent spotting, C5 B.Ed admission; none touches period allocation in the timetable.

No extract is about generators for police stations, hospitals or revenue offices during floods. C1 covers diesel generators for water supply schemes, C3 dam generators, C5 repair of generators in housing tenements, C2 weather forecasting and C4 septage management.

cited.quote: In the first phase, i.e., during the year 2024-25, one lakh new houses have been taken up for construction.
The unit cost per house is Rs.3.50 lakh,

rationale: C2 reports a rural concrete (RCC roof) housing scheme with one lakh houses taken up in 2024-25, but at a unit cost of Rs.3.50 lakh, below the promised Rs.4 lakh. Scope is real but amount is reduced. The date is only the year given in C2, no GO is in the extracts; the urban schemes in C1 and C3 are for a different group.

cited.quote: Mannargudi – Needamangala m BGL Conversion

rationale: C1 lists railway land acquisition projects, including a Mannargudi–Needamangala conversion and a Pattukottai junction point, but no Mannargudi–Mathukkur–Pattukottai new broad gauge line. This is only related activity; no extract shows an official step for the promised line.

cited.quote: Government of Tamil Nadu launched Community-Based Organized Cancer Screening in 4 districts
thereby creating awareness of the need for early screening and detection of these common

rationale: Directional promise. C4 reports an official programme launched on 22.11.2023 for breast, cervical and oral cancer screening that creates awareness among women; C5 (GO of 2025) upscales it with community awareness activities and C2/C3 add a cancer mission. The first dedicated measure is the 2023 launch, though it is mainly a screening programme.

cited.quote: Necessary IEC tools will be developed and will be disseminated through social media.

rationale: C3 and C4 (GO of 2025-07-01 approving the Cancer Care Mission document) plan IEC tools, hoardings and bus panels, all in future tense. No extract shows pamphlets or advertisements actually released by the health department. The approval is an official preparatory step only.

cited.quote: is at present Rs.10 lakh, which is increased from Rs.7 lakh

rationale: C1 (Policy Note 2023-24) states the assistance to legal heirs of deceased advocates from the Advocates Welfare Fund is now Rs.10 lakh, increased from Rs.7 lakh, matching the promise. No GO is in the extracts, so the date is only the document year.

cited.quote: Administrative Sanction is accorded for a sum of Rs.100.00 Crore
From 2021-2022 onwards Namakku Naame Thittam (NNT) is again implemented with the following

rationale: C1 (GO 147 of 14.12.2021) sanctions and revives Namakku Naame Thittam, continued by C3-C5 in 2022-23. No extract shows the Anna Marumalarchi scheme being re-implemented, so only one of the two schemes is shown.

cited.quote: Cancellation of the Minor punishment to the Police Personnel
The above cancellation of the punishment is a one time welfare measure for police personnel

rationale: C1 and C2 are G.O.(Ms) No.559 dated 07.12.2021 cancelling minor punishments under rule 3(a) for police personnel following the Chief Minister's announcement of 13.09.2021. It matches the promise, with prospective effect only.

cited.quote: the Unique Disability Identification cards have also been issued by the Government of India

rationale: Extracts show UDID cards generated by the Government of India and state identity cards issued on disability certificates; no extract shows a state order or scheme launching a smart card for persons with disabilities. UDID is a Union scheme, not a state step on this commitment.

cited.quote: Other gadgets viz., Wi-fi/LAN, smart class, Learning Management System, audio video

rationale: C2 (audit of 2019-20) finds Wi-fi/LAN unavailable in sampled college classrooms. C1 and C4 are a lab for two engineering colleges with LAN, not wi-fi for all institutions. No extract shows an official step to equip all educational institutions with wi-fi.

cited.quote: The installation of Tail end regulators which prevent the intrusion of seawater depends on the following parameters

rationale: C5 (GO 22 of 2025-06-06) frames guidelines and a committee for a programme that includes tail end regulators to prevent seawater intrusion and store freshwater. This is an official preparatory step; no extract shows such gates sanctioned or built. C1-C3 are repairs of existing sluice shutters.

cited.quote: DPR and Transaction advisory (TA) for 60 MLD capacity plant proposed by SIPCOT, at Mullakadu in Thoothukudi district

rationale: C3 shows a DPR and transaction advisory for a 60 MLD plant at Mullakadu, Thoothukudi at tendering stage; C1 reports a 400 MLD Perur plant sanctioned and at tendering stage, and C2 DPRs for Marakkanam and Ramanathapuram plants. These are preparatory or tender steps, not operational extension to other coastal areas.
No extract is about an Erode-Pazhani broad gauge line. C1, C2 and C4 are about Chennai Metro Rail, C3 sports facilities and C5 the logistics policy.

No extract shows an Assembly resolution, letter or order urging the Union government to legislate reservation in High Court and Supreme Court judges' appointments. C1 and C3 are general judiciary policy notes, C2 NEET admissions, C4 and C5 other service rules.

cited.quote: financial assistance of Rs.25,000 for non-graduates and Rs.50,000 for degree / diploma holders
will continue to be implemented without any change

rationale: C1 (2025) still shows Rs.25,000 for non-graduates with an 8 gram gold coin, the same as C3 (2022); the gold coin existed since 2016. C4 says the scheme continues without change. No extract shows an increase to Rs.30,000.

cited.quote: introducing trip cards with discounted fares, access improvements and multimodal integration

rationale: C1-C3 list free bus travel concessions for students, not metro. C4 mentions CMRL trip cards with discounted fares for riders generally, not a student metro fare subsidy. No extract shows an official step for student metro fares.
No extract is about a probe into Jayalalithaa's death or action against offenders. The extracts are crime statistics, vigilance and disciplinary procedures, and school child-safety orders.
